# Send a boutique a priced line sheet, and know your margin at wholesale.

> Free wholesale line sheet maker for makers and small brands: set wholesale prices from MSRP or cost, check your margin and the retailer's margin, simulate boutique orders with tier discounts and minimums, and print a priced line sheet. No signup, works offline, data stays on your device.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
